author: John7572
quote:
I want to be clear: if this were a debut installment in an entirely new franchise, I'd give it a 10/10. Well, maybe an 8 or 9; I genuinely don't like some of the writing and some of the voice acting. 

This isn't a debut game, however. It's an established franchise. 

The biggest departure, in my estimation, is the transition from wholesale caricature to grounded character drama. That's what I miss. The parody of it all. And don't get me wrong, there's some of that, but crucially, it has been completely turned away from the protagonists and aimed outward. 

Why does that matter?

People forget, but that was actually the narrative formula of the franchise running up until GTA V: a cold killer reacting to a ludicrous world and even wackier NPCs. 
But those games always had a problem. 
There was a constant friction between a serious protagonist and a sandbox that was so utterly cartoonish and unhinged that the lead felt out of place. 

GTA V came in with the antidote. 
Make the playable characters just as ridiculous as the world they live in. And it was a masterpiece. I mean, true spectacle. 
Finally, your indiscriminate murder sprees and carte blanche criminal enterprise made sense, because the characters you played as were literal nut jobs, each in their own way, not anti-heroes with tangible stakes. 

Where Rockstar went wrong was assuming that because their fans enjoyed the earnest melodrama from RDR2, the audience had somehow "matured" and moved past what made GTA V a generational piece of entertainment. 

One little problem. This is GTA, not Red Dead. 

I loved Red Dead Redemption when it came out. Had Undead Nightmare and everything. And RDR2, don't get me started. Masterpiece. The thing is, those games were built first and foremost as revisionist Westerns with tragic comedy. True dramas. 

That's not the DNA of GTA, which, from the very beginning, was about excess. GTA V was the ultimate realisation of that original architecture. 

As a technical achievement and a standalone crime game, it’s an 8 or 9 out of 10. As a Grand Theft Auto game, measured against the DNA it abandoned, it’s a 0/10.
